operational-example.copy: Use Radio Button when one option belongs to an exclusive decision and the option itself needs a visible label, state, and optional support text.

items.label: Fastest route
items.description: Prioritize arrival time for active deliveries.

items.label: Lowest fuel cost
items.description: Use lower-cost stations even if route time increases.

items.label: Manual review
items.description: Requires dispatcher approval before route starts.

rationale: Each row is one option in a mutually exclusive decision.
The selected dot makes the current choice visible without hiding the label.
Group orchestration belongs to a future Radio Group pattern, not the atomic control.
